svg.desc: Vietnamese sentiment, PhoBERT (…/Sentiment_Analysis_Using_PhoBert_Trained): Fine-tunes PhoBERT on UIT-VSFC student feedback to label Vietnamese text as positive, negative or neutral, with Hugging Face Transformers. Stack: PhoBERT, Transformers, NLP.
